captions.Fig01_reference_load_directions: 1,927 material points and 1,561 fixed anchors; all 453 loaded IDs colored. Forty-eight deterministic farthest-point arrows show forces at the reference geometry and unit pulse amplitude, 120 micrometres per micronewton. Direction is fixed in reference space; the actual Gaussian uses moving coordinates. Geometry is not scaled. Normal orientation and same-input force magnitudes are independently checked.
captions.Fig02a_matched_V3_states: Requested matching times [ms]: 0.000000, 0.118000, 0.500000. Each panel labels its actual accepted time. Nearest saved state matching is recorded with exact offsets in VISUAL_STATE_MATCHING.json; no interpolated nodes or fracture events. All live bulk bonds are drawn; interface/scaffold lines omitted for readability.
captions.Fig02b_matched_V3_states: Requested matching times [ms]: 0.800000, 1.250000, 2.330000. Each panel labels its actual accepted time. Nearest saved state matching is recorded with exact offsets in VISUAL_STATE_MATCHING.json; no interpolated nodes or fracture events. All live bulk bonds are drawn; interface/scaffold lines omitted for readability.
captions.Fig02c_first_failure_events: Complement to the matched-time panels: each case at its own first natural bulk failure. Both event time and actual saved display time are explicit; these two panels are not a simultaneous comparison. Common camera and physical bounds are retained.
captions.Fig03_local_cohesion: Orange highlights the selected original identity set, not an artificially merged fragment. Gold lines: surviving internal bonds; black: surviving external bonds; faint red: originally external bonds that actually failed. Exact formation event topology is in JSON; a sampled display time is labeled explicitly if no full nodal state exists at that event. Negative candidate results use the unchanged prior graph criteria. IDs and internal survival are retained in CHUNK_COHESION_AUDIT.json.
captions.Fig03b_damage_organization: Original reference bond midpoints colored by actual full-failure time. Common reference coordinates distinguish changes in where damage initiates and spreads. A connected damage cloud is not a reconstructed continuous crack surface; bulk and interface regions are quantified separately in BULK_INTERFACE_FAILURE_AUDIT.json.
captions.Fig04_actual_fragment_sizes: Historical maxima and final sizes are distinguished. Component membership uses live original bulk/interface paths to fixed anchors, never contact proximity. The 200/300 micrometre labels are equivalent reference-volume thresholds, not converged physical size or clinical safety targets.
captions.Fig05a_forces_work_energy: Same scalar load rule is not equal actual work. Exact force-displacement work and independent residual are preserved; the residual is not damage dissipation. Force magnitude is computed at each case’s own evolving coordinates. Full signed force vector and all channels are in the FP64 history.
captions.Fig05b_contact_and_typed_failures: Complementary channels in W_load+W_drag+W_numeric+W_wall_damping=ΔU+ΔK+D+ΔUc+ΔUw−Jc+R. Wall elastic work is recorded separately and not counted again as external input when wall storage Uw is included.
captions.Fig05c_pulse_and_resultant: The original pulse is inherited without override. Resultants differ from the sum of individual force magnitudes because the outward normal varies across the curved surface. Wall elastic work is a diagnostic channel and is not double counted in the primary ledger.
captions.Fig06_evidence_and_cost: Summary of actual accepted numerical results; neither normal traction nor the retained artificial C1 loading is a verified microbubble force. A single direction comparison cannot identify equal-input-energy efficiency or calibrate material Gc.
